gen-gf-paprika-gf-kadwa: Kadwa takes the text serif role with open-ended curves and an x-height taller than you'd expect. Kadwa's quiet editorial manner gives Paprika's scattered, capital-sized lowercase something steady to stand against.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text enters every curve with a big, visible hook. Beside it, Paprika's commanding display letters sit far apart, and that gap between loud and literary is what makes the two memorable.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-piazzolla: Paprika spreads its letters wide, with lowercase that fills the line like capitals and gives the heading real command. But Piazzolla does the finer work below, with lowercase nearly matching its capitals and an e opened like a pried clasp.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-pridi: Pridi reads with small letters standing proud, almost capital-sized, and generous gaps between curve ends and stems. Paprika then supplies the loud display voice above, so enlarge Pridi a little.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-scope-one: Commanding from the first word, Paprika sets its letters well apart and lets the lowercase fill the line. Scope One answers in a traditional voice, its counters spilling outward beside stubby ascenders and a big x-height.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-slabo-13px: Paprika leads with commanding display letters, lowercase swelling to fill the line like capitals. And Slabo 13px follows with bookish, dignified serif text whose tall a, e and s stay open, so pages would read smoothly.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified and editorial, Suwannaphum has a squared-off, woodblock-high x-height and a c as open as a bent paperclip. Paprika is best at commanding attention up top; Suwannaphum is best at holding it.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Padyakke Expanded One reads wide and literary, each c a pitcher's mouth and each glyph spaced like knots on a slack rope. And Phudu, bold and distinctive with ballpoint-plain lines, gives it a punchy opener.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded reads with every character floating apart, a pipe-cleaner feel in each letterform. Stint Ultra Expanded carries the authority here, while Phudu is best at bold, distinctive display lines with open curve terminals.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-stint-ultra-expa: Bold and expressive, Pixelify Sans keeps a steady line weight and a c as open as a bent paperclip. But Stint Ultra Expanded does the traditional, authoritative work, its characters floating apart in a text serif voice.
